title: Zimbabwe PRAZ Tender Scraper Input
description: Scrape public PRAZ eGP tenders with reliable pagination, filters, monitoring alerts, evidence-based requirements, and optional public PDF analysis.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: Public PRAZ eGP bulletin board URL.

maxItems.title: Maximum tenders
maxItems.description: Maximum number of records saved to the dataset.

includeDetails.title: Include tender detail pages
includeDetails.description: Visit individual tender pages for richer fields and requirement extraction.

keyword.title: Keyword filter
keyword.description: Search title, reference, buyer, category, location, and verified requirements.

buyerKeyword.title: Buyer filter
buyerKeyword.description: Filter by procuring entity, such as ZETDC, a council, ministry, or agency.

categoryKeyword.title: Category filter
categoryKeyword.description: Filter by supplier category or category code.

statusKeyword.title: Status filter
statusKeyword.description: Filter by status, for example Open.

procurementMethodKeyword.title: Procurement method filter
procurementMethodKeyword.description: Filter by procurement method after detail enrichment.

classOfProcurementKeyword.title: Procurement class filter
classOfProcurementKeyword.description: Filter by Works, Goods, Services, or another public procurement class.

businessCategory.title: Business category filter
businessCategory.description: Filter generated categories such as Construction, ICT, Medical, Energy, or Other.

onlyOpen.title: Only open tenders
onlyOpen.description: Keep only Open, Published, or Active tenders. Deadline scoring still detects expired dates.

minimumDaysRemaining.title: Minimum days remaining
minimumDaysRemaining.description: Minimum days before closing; use 0 to disable.

maximumDaysRemaining.title: Maximum days remaining
maximumDaysRemaining.description: Maximum days before closing; use 0 to disable.

newOnly.title: New and changed tenders only
newOnly.description: Requires stateStoreId. Returns unseen tenders plus meaningful updates according to the monitoring options.

detectChanges.title: Detect tender changes
detectChanges.description: Compare status, closing date, and a material tender fingerprint across runs when stateStoreId is configured.

includeStatusChanges.title: Include status-change alerts
includeStatusChanges.description: When newOnly is enabled, include existing tenders whose status changed.

stateStoreId.title: Isolated monitoring state store ID
stateStoreId.description: Optional user-owned Apify Key-Value Store ID or name. Use a separate store per customer or monitoring task. Leave blank to disable cross-run monitoring.

resetSeenTenders.title: Reset monitoring state
resetSeenTenders.description: Clear the selected stateStoreId before this run. Requires stateStoreId.

memoryStoreName.title: Legacy memory store name
memoryStoreName.description: Deprecated and ignored for isolation safety. Use stateStoreId instead.

extractRequirements.title: Extract tender requirements
extractRequirements.description: Use deterministic rules to extract only requirement signals supported by accessible HTML or analyzed PDFs.

analyzeDocuments.title: Analyze public PDF documents
analyzeDocuments.description: Download and parse trusted, public PRAZ PDFs within the configured limits. Disabled by default for cost control.

maxDocumentsPerTender.title: Maximum PDFs per tender
maxDocumentsPerTender.description: Maximum PDF files to analyze for each tender.

maxDocumentSizeMB.title: Maximum PDF size (MB)
maxDocumentSizeMB.description: Skip public PDFs larger than this limit.

documentTextMaxChars.title: Maximum extracted document text
documentTextMaxChars.description: Maximum characters retained from analyzed PDFs per tender.
